name: 6.6ft Soft Tri-Fold Tonneau Cover for 2014-2019 Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra 1500 (2019 Legacy ONLY); 2015-2019 Silverado Sierra 2500 3500 HD Without Multi flex Tailgate
fitment:
Compatible with: 2014-2018 Chevy Silverado / GMC Sierra 1500 | Fleetside 6.6' Bed.
Compatible with: 2019 Chevy Silverado 1500 LD / GMC Sierra 1500 LT ; 2019 Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra 2500 3500 HD | Fleetside 6.6' Bed.
Note: For 2019, it only fits Classic or Legendary models.
NOT FIT Multi-flex tailgate & Utility track system.
warnings: 官网质保弹窗引用其他品牌
description:
OEDRO's trifold truck bed tonneau cover gives your truck the perfect combination of security, convenience and appearance. It is easy to install and the tailgate lock turns your truck bed into a completely secure trunk which is snow proof and dust-proof.
Features
Security. When transporting valuable items, a tonneau cover can help to protect them from theft. OEDRO tonneau covers are hard and difficult to break into. They are feature secure locking mechanisms. tonneau cover keeps the goods out of sight, and potential thieves will not know what is in the truck bed.
Protection from Damage. Tonneau cover protects items from damage by the elements. During bad weather, such as rainy or snowy days, a tonneau cover can help shield the goods being hauled. The cover also offers protection from other elements such as wind, dust, and others.
Better Gas Mileage Performance. Tonneau cover helps to reduce the drag. That, in, turn means less power to move the vehicle, and reduced fuel consumption.
It Holds Things in Place. It is not uncommon for items to shift in a truck bed, sometimes even fly off when the vehicle is speeding on a highway. A bed cover can easily prevent that. By keeping everything in its place, saves the truck owner the loss that may result from things knocking against others, or spilling on the road and getting damaged or lost.
Enhanced Aesthetics. OEDRO tonneau cover can provide a neat, clean look. Drivers with beds that are old, rusty, or otherwise dinged up can easily cover up the damage with a quality truck bed cover that keeps all of your possessions hidden from view.
1-year warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Fitment
Compatible with: 2014-2018 Chevy Silverado / GMC Sierra 1500 | Fleetside 6.6' Bed.
Compatible with: 2019 Chevy Silverado 1500 LD / GMC Sierra 1500 LT ; 2019 Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra 2500 3500 HD | Fleetside 6.6' Bed.
Note: For 2019, it only fits Classic or Legendary models.
NOT FIT Multi-flex tailgate & Utility track system.
